headline: Andrew Cuomo on new ICE-OKX crypto joint venture, Clarity Act and prediction markets
summary: Andrew Cuomo, OKX joint venture co-chairman, OKX board member and former New York Governor, joins 'Squawk Box' to discuss details of a new joint venture between Intercontinental Exchange and OKX, his thoughts on prediction markets, state of the Democratic Party, and more.
